messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert triggered: PD-44821 — serving-prod queue_depth across inference-shard-usw2 > 2000 for 7m. Severity: P1. Impact: increased tail latency (~30% reqs >10s), elevated 502/503 from gateway. Dashboards: https://grafana.prod/serving/queues, PD: https://pd.app/incidents/PD-44821
PagerDuty: Alert routed to eng-oncall, infra-capacity.
Zoey M: ACK PD-44821. I'm on rotation. Starting a quick blast-radius triage.
Diego R: Noted. Pulling cluster events and autoscaler logs.
Priya N: Opening a brief incident doc: INC-992. I'll update statuspage to "partial outage - US-WEST-2" and ping CSM.
Connor H: Any deploys in last 20m?
Zoey M: Deploy bot shows no recent prod deploys.
Diego R: Relevant outputs:
```
$ kubectl -n kube-system logs deployment/cluster-autoscaler
I0412 12:02:10.123456 1 scale.go:234] scale up: no candidates found (instances quota exceeded)
E0412 12:03:05.987654 1 leaderelection.go:324] failed to acquire lease: server responded with 429 Too Many Requests
E0412 12:03:30.001234 1 leaderelection.go:324] lost leadership, retrying
```
Cloud API: returns 429/403 intermittently when attempting instance pool expand in us-west-2. Provider case #CASE-789 opened earlier for quota/provisioning disruptions.
Zoey M: So autoscaler can't acquire leadership consistently and cloud API is throttling instance creation. That explains the backlog.
Priya N: Customer impact: Hosted API customers in us-west-2 are seeing slow responses and intermittent 5xx. I'll escalate to support-leads and draft an outbound note.
Connor H: Quick mitigations: (A) Shed non-critical traffic with a rate-limiter at the edge, (B) scale down batch/ML-training jobs to free node slots, (C) manual replica bump on hot deployments but bounded by current node capacity. Which to do first?
Diego R: I'll cordon the k8s node-pool labeled "batch" and drain batch jobs to free capacity. Doing `kubectl cordon` + `kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` for batch nodes.
Zoey M: I'm enabling edge rate-limit for non-SLAs to 5rps/user and flipping the quick-fallback route that serves cached responses for frequent prompts. Edge change: `PATCH /edge/config` done.
Connor H: Trying a conservative manual scale on the inference deployment to 48 replicas (current 30) to use freed slots. `kubectl scale deploy/inference -n serving --replicas=48`
Diego R: Some pods stayed Pending with reason: "InsufficientInstanceCapacity". Others started. Autoscaler still in backoff due to 429s.
ops-bot: Note: automatic scale-group update failed for nodegroup-usw2-1 — API quota hit.
Priya N: Also toggled proxy connection pool increase for front-door to reduce 502s: `runtime-config:set proxy.conn_pool=400`. Applying now.
Zoey M: Observability: queue length dropped from ~2200 -> 1300 in 6m after rate-limits + draining batch. Tail latency P99 improved slightly. 5xx rate down from 5% -> 1.8%.
Diego R: I'll attempt a restart of cluster-autoscaler to force a fresh leader election — hoping it recovers outside of the API throttle window. `kubectl -n kube-system rollout restart deployment/cluster-autoscaler`
Zoey M: Restarted. Watching logs.
Diego R: Autoscaler re-acquired leadership but still seeing `quota exceeded` on instance create. Opening emergency cloud support chat.
Priya N: Support pinged CSMs and key customers. Created a low-noise broadcast for enterprise tenants.
Connor H: Another mitigation: enable preemptible/spot fallback nodegroup for burst capacity (if API allows). Diego, can you try toggling nodegroup `usw2-burst` to allow scaling of spot instances?
Diego R: Triggering scale-up on burst nodegroup via API; response: accepted but throttled — it's in progress, not instant.
ops-bot: Provider update: provisioning backlog reported in us-west-2. ETA unknown.
Zoey M: Given provider ETA unknown, we're keeping rate-limits and fallback routes for now. Queue at ~600 and decreasing.
Priya N: Statuspage updated: Degraded performance for Hosted API (us-west-2). Internal incident INC-992 created and linked.
Connor H: Post-incident temp measures we should record: (1) edge rate-limits for non-SLA routes, (2) batch job drain playbook, (3) a config flag to reduce max model size for low-tier traffic.
Diego R: Cloud provider replied in chat: working on provisioning backlog; advised to file quota increase if we need sustained capacity. Filed CASE-790 requesting emergency quota bump for us-west-2.
Zoey M: Queue under 200 now. Errors largely resolved. Monitoring for reappearance.
Priya N: I'm preparing a short customer note and will coordinate with comms.
Diego R: Autoscaler logs now show successful rescale events as burst nodes come up: `scale up: new size 60` — cluster capacity increasing.
Zoey M: P99 latency back to baseline; p50 healthy. PD-44821 will stay open for five more minutes of stability.
PagerDuty: PD-44821 acknowledged by Zoey M at 3698765550.
Zoey M: Confirming stable for 10m, marking PD resolved and closing page.
PagerDuty: PD-44821 resolved by Zoey M at 3698765699.
Zoey M: Preliminary RCA: Provider-side provisioning delays + API throttling caused cluster-autoscaler leadership/backoff, which prevented timely node creation; backlog increased and gateway connection pools were exhausted. Actions: 1) add alert on autoscaler API 429s and leader-election errors, 2) implement burst spot nodegroup failover runbook, 3) add circuit-breaker + cached-fallback for top N routes, 4) open follow-up with provider to improve capacity/resilience. I'll file postmortem in INC-992 with timeline and owners. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
